visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up shot focusing on a vibrant red 'NETFLIX' sign set under a white canopy tent, followed by a medium shot of a woman with short dark hair wearing a green tracksuit featuring the number 188. She is walking away from the camera across a large stone-tiled plaza towards the National Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall under a bright, cloudless blue summer sky. (2) A pink circular fan is displayed, featuring a cartoonish illustration of the 'Young-hee' doll's face from the show, along with the text 'THE FINAL GAME' and 'Squid Game 3'. The woman in the green 188 tracksuit turns toward the camera, smiling warmly and holding a water bottle, while a large crowd of people with umbrellas and casual summer wear fills the background plaza. (3) The scene shifts to an indoor-outdoor setting under a large tent where the woman is being filmed and interviewed. She appears animated and nervous, frequently touching her hair and adjusting her collar, while a staff member wearing a black hat and white shirt stands nearby. Red and white variety-style captions pop up on the screen to emphasize her reactions. (4) Outside again, the woman stands in front of a giant animatronic Young-hee doll situated on a raised platform, surrounded by onlookers and cameras. She explains the concept of '科技跳繩' to the camera with high energy and wide eyes, gesturing towards the doll and the surrounding event infrastructure, while the bright daylight creates a high-contrast cinematic lighting effect. (5) The woman participates in the virtual skipping rope challenge on a large outdoor LED screen displaying character avatars. A staff member in a full red guard jumpsuit stands beside her, monitoring the game while she jumps vigorously in place. She successfully completes the round, smiles broadly at the camera, and holds up a personalized ID card with her photo and the player number 962 as a souvenir of the event.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and promote the 'Squid Game 3' promotional event held by Netflix at the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall in Taipei. The creator shares her personal and humorous experience participating in the themed challenges to engage her audience and build anticipation for the show.
